item.title: Police investigate machete attack that injured man in Seattle's Central District
item.description: Seattle police are searching for a suspect after a machete attack inside an RV in the Central District left a man with a serious hand injury.

item.title: Worst snowpack in decades puts WA ski season in jeopardy
item.description: Washington ski resorts are facing one of the worst snowpack years in decades, leaving slopes closed and skiers questioning whether the season is already over.

item.title: April-like weather in Seattle on Thursday
item.description: Sunshine increases this afternoon with April-like temperatures climbing into the upper 50s to low 60s around Puget Sound.

item.title: If Seahawks win Super Bowl 2026, will Seattle host a parade?
item.description: Seattle’s last Super Bowl celebration offers a clear example of how the city has handled a moment like this before. Here's what we know.

item.title: Bremerton, WA Seahawks fan drives to California in his ‘Hawk Rod’
item.description: Seattle Seahawks fans are showing up for the Super Bowl this weekend, and there's one 12 you can't possibly miss as he pulls up to the biggest tailgate parties in his 'Hawk Rod.'

item.title: Suspect of fatal Renton, WA shooting held without bail
item.description: The suspect of a deadly shooting outside a popular neighborhood market in Renton is currently in custody on probable cause for murder, though prosecutors have not yet filed formal charges.

item.title: Is this the most decorated Seahawks house in Washington?
item.description: Located about three hours outside Seattle is possibly the most Seahawks-decorated home in the state.

item.title: Sam Darnold a full participant, Nick Emmanwori DNP at practice for Seattle Seahawks
item.description: Quarterback Sam Darnold was back to full participation for the Seattle Seahawks on Thursday, while safety Nick Emmanwori sat out after injuring his ankle in practice this week.

item.title: Seahawks receiver Jaxon Smith-Njigba named NFL AP Offensive Player of the Year
item.description: Seahawks wide receiver Jaxon Smith-Njigba was named the AP NFL Offensive Player of the Year on Thursday night after a record-setting season in Seattle.

item.title: Former Seahawk Bobby Wagner named NFL's Walter Payton Man of the Year
item.description: Former Seahawks linebacker Bobby Wagner - now with the Washington Commanders - was named the NFL's Walter Payton Man of the Year for his charitable efforts for stroke research and rehabilitation.
